data.desc: Liquidia Corporation is a biopharmaceutical company driven by science and compassion to revolutionize care for patients with challenging respiratory and vascular diseases. The company's current focus spans the development and commercialization of products in pulmonary hypertension and other applications of its proprietary PRINT Technology. PRINT enabled the creation of YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder, a drug approved in 2025 for the treatment of PAH. YUTREPIA is currently under development for other indications, including SSc-RP and PH-COPD. The company is also developing L606, an investigational extended-release formulation of treprostinil administered twice daily with a next-generation nebulizer.
